name: Immerhalm
body:
An immerhalm is a vanguard that realizes that sometimes the best defense is a good offence. What better way to defend their allies than with a big hammer, axe or sword?

Furious Focus (Ex)

At 2nd level, the immerhalm gains Power Attack and Furious Focus as a bonus feats.

At 6th level and every four thereafter the immerhalm reduces the penalty on all attack rolls from the Power Attack feat by 1 (minimum -0).

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian and shield focus and their improvements.

Weapon Training (Ex)

At 5th level and every four levels thereafter, the immerhalm gains weapon training as the fighter class feature of the same name, except they must choose a weapon group that includes a two handed melee weapon. This allows the vanguard to select an advanced weapon training instead of a weapon training after the first weapon training at 5th level.

This ability replaces all instances of armor training.

Backswing (Ex)

At 6th level, once per round when the immerhalm misses an attack benefiting from Power Attack they may make an additional attack at the same attack bonus with double the normal attack penalty for Power Attack. This penalty on the attack roll is not reduced by feats or special abilities the immerhalm possess.

This ability replaces active defense and its improvements.

Take the Advantage (Ex)

At 7th level, the immerhalm gains the ability to use press the advantage with a two handed melee weapon rather than as a shield bash.

This ability alters press the advantage and improved press the advantage.

Greater Power Attack (Ex)

At 8th level, when the immerhalm uses Power Attack they now add twice the damage bonus, rather than one-and-a-half times, when using a two handed melee weapon.

This ability replaces bulwark.

Follow Through (Ex)

At 8th level, whenever the immerhalm deals damage with a two handed melee weapon they add twice their strength bonus to the damage roll rather than one and a half times.

This ability replaces brace.

Weapon Mastery (Ex)

At 20th level, the immerhalm chooses one two handed melee weapon. Any attacks made with that weapon automatically confirm all critical threats and have their damage multiplier increased by 1 (×2 becomes ×3, for example). In addition, they cannot be disarmed while wielding a weapon of this type. By spending one hour in contemplation and practice with a weapon the immerhalm may change the weapon chosen for this ability.

This ability replaces second skin.
